messages:
maria: quick thought — can we gate the compact_metrics read-adapter behind a feature flag and dualwrite for 2 weeks before backfilling? want minimal risk for console dashboards :thinking:

devon: +1 on feature flag. question: do we dualwrite synchronously or async?

sam: sync dualwrite will spike p99 on ingest path. i'd prefer async with at-least-once backfill job and tombstone on failure.

maria: ok noted. proposal: sync for critical fields (route_id, ts, tokens) + async append for optional attrs. that keeps console fast while we iterate.

luke: also we should add a read-adapter that maps old envelope->compact shape for queries, so dashboards don't change. adapter can be a thin SQL view or a service layer.

sam: SQL view might be easiest for short-term. example: ```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW console_metrics_v2 AS
SELECT route_id, time_bucket('1m', ts) AS minute, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM compact_metrics
GROUP BY 1,2;
```

devon: materialized view ok but need refresh strategy and concurrency controls. also worried about backfill throughput on large tenants. maybe per-tenant backfill queue with rate limiting.

maria: agreed. plan draft: 1) add feature flag + schema (compact_metrics) 2) dualwrite sync minimal schema 3) start async dualwrite/append queue for details 4) materialized view read-adapter 5) gradual backfill by tenant with throttling 6) 2-week darklaunch then flip reads.

luke: add rollback signal hook: ingest-bot should emit a metric when dualwrite errors >0.5% for 5m and auto-disable flag + alert.

ingest-bot: monitor:compact_dualwrite_errors = 0.0 (simulated) :robot_face:

sam: what about telemetry tracing and tracing IDs across writes? we need to correlate old->new for debugging. include trace_id in writes.

maria: good call. include trace_id, and store last_write_status (OK/ERR) on compact_metrics for quick sampling.

devon: rollout timeline ok but we need a migration window for queries that rely on event envelope fields. add a readfallthrough: if field missing in compact_metrics, fallback to events table for that route.

luke: fallback implemented in read-adapter layer, not view. view stays fast; adapter queries both when flag off.

maria: action items: @devon create feature-flag + schema PR, @sam prototype view + backfill worker, @luke add ingest-bot rollback metric hook. i'll draft runbook for rollback and safe toggles. target start Monday.

devon: will do. sharing mock DDL in PR.

sam: i'll bench backfill on staging with our biggest tenant dataset. will post numbers. :mag:

maria: thanks all. if anyone spots a blocker call it out here, otherwise i'll post the runbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
